title.en: AN ACT APPROPRIATING ONE THOUSAND ONE HUNDRED AND SEVENTEEN DOLLARS AND THIRTY CENTS, IN MEXICAN CURRENCY, FOR THE PURPOSE OF ESTABLISHING AND MAINTAINING SCHOOLS IN THE ISLAND OF LUBAN.
title.orig: AN ACT APPROPRIATING ONE THOUSAND ONE HUNDRED AND SEVENTEEN DOLLARS AND THIRTY CENTS, IN MEXICAN CURRENCY, FOR THE PURPOSE OF ESTABLISHING AND MAINTAINING SCHOOLS IN THE ISLAND OF LUBAN.
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp kinh phí một nghìn một trăm mười bảy đô la Mỹ và ba mươi xu tiền Mexico để thiết lập và duy trì các trường học trên đảo Luban
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดสรรงบประมาณหนึ่งพันหนึ่งร้อยสิบเจ็ดดอลลาร์สหรัฐและสามสิบเซนต์สกุลเงินเม็กซิโกเพื่อจัดตั้งและบำรุงรักษาโรงเรียนบนเกาะลูบัน
title.id: Undang-Undang yang Mengalokasikan Seribu Seratus Tujuh Belas Dolar Amerika Serikat dan Tiga Puluh Sen dalam Mata Uang Meksiko untuk Membangun dan Memelihara Sekolah di Pulau Luban
title.ms: Akta yang Mengeluarkan Seribu Seratus Tujuh Belas Dolar Amerika Syarikat dan Tiga Puluh Sen dalam Mata Wang Mexico bagi Membina dan Menyelenggara Sekolah di Pulau Luban

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil PDF 文本化成果（第三方 OCR，非机翻），原始文件 ACT_00248_1901_html.txt

text.en:
The sum of one thousand one hundred and seventeen dollars and thirty cents, in Mexican
currency, an amount collected under military authority in the Island of Luban and deposited in the Insular
Treasury, is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to be
expended under the direction of the General Superintendent of Public Instruction for the purpose of
establishing and maintaining schools in the Island of Luban.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, October 2, 1901.
